interactions.prompt: A small cup is our measuring cup. Which picture shows one full cup?
interactions.feedback: Yes! Use the same full cup each time.
interactions.retryHint: Look for the cup filled right to its top line.

interactions.prompt: Watch Amani fill a jug with the same small cup. Four full cups fill the jug. Tap 4.
interactions.feedback: Great measuring! The jug holds 4 small cups.
interactions.retryHint: Count only the full small cups: 1, 2, 3, 4.

interactions.prompt: Help Zuri measure the bottle. Tap a cup each time it is poured in, then choose how many cups fill it.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap each cup in order, then tap the number of cups.
interactions.feedback: Well done! The bottle holds 3 small cups.
interactions.retryHint: Use the same full cup. Count each pour: 1, 2, 3.

interactions.prompt: Measure the cooking pot with the same tin. It takes 5 full tins. Tap the number that tells its capacity.
interactions.retryHint: Count the full tins, not the container itself.

interactions.prompt: At the school garden, a watering can fills with 6 yoghurt cups. Build the measurement by tapping six cups, then tap 6.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the cups one at a time, then choose the matching number.
interactions.feedback: Wonderful! The watering can holds 6 yoghurt cups.
interactions.retryHint: Keep using one kind of cup and count every full cup.

interactions.prompt: Show what you know. A bucket fills with 8 scoops of sand. Tap the measurement.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! The bucket holds 8 scoops of sand.
interactions.retryHint: Count the same-sized scoops from 1 up to 8.
